reviews.text: Aarav debugged my state logic in ten minutes, then made me explain it back to him. That is the best kind of teacher.
Asked exactly the right questions and then taught me the calculus behind the graph problem. Fair trade.
Whiteboard-first teaching really worked for graphs. Slightly fast at the end when we hit recursion.
Came prepared and took notes the whole way through. Good energy.
Two hours and my line drawings stopped wobbling. She has a real system, not just talent.
Made joins visual with actual diagrams. I still look at the sketch when I write queries.
Turned up with questions already written down. Learner every tutor wants.
Made me shoot in manual for the first time and gave very specific feedback on each frame. Would do a second session.
Lovely to teach. Already had a strong visual instinct, just needed structure.
She cut my portfolio from nine screens to four and it finally made sense. Ruthless in the best way.
Sharp questions, quick learner. Paid me back in Spanish phrases on the spot.
Rebuilt my whole model live and explained why the old one broke. Genuinely useful, no fluff.
Dev taught me fingerstyle in a way that stuck. Patient, structured, and hilarious about my thumb.
She had me ordering food in Spanish by the end of the hour. Nothing else came close to that.

Send me what you have — I will read it before we meet so we do not spend the hour setting up.
You are a legend. Repo link incoming tonight.
